messages:
shrey: Opening thread for tonight's v2 rollout (change window 2024-08-28T02:00Z). Any tenant holds or schema compatibility concerns?

deploy-bot: Scheduled by @shrey for 2024-08-28T02:00Z. Plan: 5% canary (10m) -> 25% (15m) -> 100% if green. Rollback triggers: global 5xx > 1.5% OR p99 delta > 50% for 10m.

alyssa: Heads-up: ~0.9% of traffic still sends legacy 'payload_v' header; parser currently returns 400 for strict mode.

paul: I prepared a fragile tenant list: s3://rwd-release/pins/fragile-2024-08-28.json (198 tenants).

shrey: Options: route-split by payload_v header or apply tenant pins. Which has lower blast radius?

ops: Route-split is safer if header is intact. Command we can apply:
```
rwdctl routes split --route /api/chat --by-header payload_v --mapping v1:legacy,v2:default
```
But proxies could strip headers.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2024-08-28T02:00Z at 5%. Monitoring baseline.

alyssa: Parser errors climbing; ~120 parse 400s in last 30s, concentrated APAC.

paul: Enabling header gate to direct payload_v=old to v1 shim. Applying now.

paul: Command:
```
rwdctl feature toggle --name header_gate_payload_v --on --scope route:/api/chat
```
Result: applied.

deploy-bot: Traffic adjusted per header gate. Canary continues 5%.

ops: Alerting: parse-error rate > 0.5% and APAC p99 jumped to +65%. Recommend containment: pin APAC-heavy tenants or rollback.

paul: Applying pins for APAC-heavy list: pins/apac-heavy-2024-08-28.json
```
rwdctl pins add --route /api/chat --tenants-file pins/apac-heavy-2024-08-28.json --reason "apac parse/perf"
```
Result: 421 tenants pinned.

deploy-bot: Canary paused by operator @paul at 2024-08-28T02:18Z. No further traffic increases.

alyssa: Parser team can deploy soft-accept mode to accept both schemas without strict validation. ETA ~30m. Will run APAC replay.

ops: Current global 5xx 0.4% but APAC p99 still high. If soft-accept reduces parse 400s to <0.2% and p99 delta <25% we resume.

release-manager: I'll update release tracker: "paused - header gate + targeted pins active; parser soft-accept in progress" and add release note: "Temporary containment applied for APAC; tenants pinned to v1 shim until parser fallback verified."

parser-bot: Staging deploy of parser soft-accept started. Running replay subset for APAC traffic. ETA 28m.

shrey: Action items: 1) alyssa validate parser soft-accept (30m), 2) ops/SRE finish traces and confirm root cause (15m), 3) release-manager update customers. Decision to resume if parse errors <0.2% and p99 delta <25%. Reconvene in this thread in 35m. Keep updates short. :thumbsup:
